name: sandbox-e2e
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project sandbox-e2e --web
// e2e: The Playwright plugin USED TO infer `dependsOn: sandbox:serve` from the config's webServer command, a CONTINUOUS task nx started before the suite and killed after it. On the runners every run that ended on this suite ended without nx's summary and with exit code 0, red tasks included — nine runs, 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-17 (plan 4.72, lesson-222). This empty list is what took the serve out of nx's graph; Playwright starts and stops the server itself, as `webServer` says. Since 2026-09-19 the plugin infers nothing here anyway: it reads a webServer command only in the two shapes nx itself prints, `nx run <project>:<target>` and `nx <target> <project>`, and skips the reading altogether for a server it may not reuse — which is why `docs-e2e` never had an inferred dependency either. The command here is now `scripts/serve-for-e2e` (lesson-231). The list stays — the guard that stopped the nine silent runs should not depend on how a command happens to be spelled. What the unparsed command DOES change is `parallelism`, which the plugin sets to false in that case and this file does not override; `playwright.config.mts` says why that is accepted.
